principles.evidence: Every factual claim must resolve to an allowed JD, CV, or USER evidence ID.
principles.contribution: Do not strengthen participation into ownership or leadership.
principles.language: Bilingual answers preserve evidence IDs, numbers, dates, units, and contribution level.
principles.privacy: Reports and evaluation artifacts exclude unnecessary personal information.
principles.honesty: Unknown details remain explicit confirmation items rather than invented facts.
principles.system_design: System-design practice is derived from JD evidence, labels assumptions, provides complete solutions and trade-offs, and never claims to reveal company-internal questions or architecture.
principles.management_interview: Management-round preparation ties concerns and answer strategies to role evidence without inventing candidate experience or people-management scope.
